source_quote: The synchronized cells were plated onto solid medium and immediately irradiated at doses varying between 1 and 15 J/m 2 . Even at the maximum dose of UV, cell viability was 70%.
notes: G1-synchronized diploid (W303a x YJM789 hybrid PG311), irradiated on plates. UV-C assigned from the paper's own statement that low UV-C (~254 nm) doses produce the pyrimidine dimers studied here; the lamp wavelength is not restated in Methods.
